title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Straight Bar | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with this 30-Inch wall mount towel bar from the Carolina Collection in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Crafted from solid brass and styled as a straight bar, it keeps bath towels handy while the wall-mounted design helps save space.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Includes mounting plates and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with Carolina Collection pieces for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Diameter: 0.75 in
- Dimensions: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
